queueDecision: No evidence-request item is closed. The full statewide report consolidates Cadillac effluent and coded landfill-SIU PFAS results, but it does not name Wexford County Landfill in that row, document individual deliveries, synchronize influent/effluent/sludge sampling or establish groundwater migration to Plett Road. The county packet preserves a proposed monitoring and remedial-action budget, not the requested certified well construction, surveyed synoptic water levels, hydraulic tests, flow map or source-to-receptor sampling package.
evidentiaryBoundary: The $57,400 figure is an estimated 2022 budget, not proof of payment or completed work. The 590 ng/L PFOA and 120 ng/L PFOS row is associated with Cadillac and a coded active Type II landfill SIU, but the report itself does not identify the facility by name or establish a delivery date, treatment-plant pass-through for that sample, or a receptor pathway.
